premises.text: Streaming economics make it very hard for artists to earn a living from recorded music
premises.evidence_span: this has made it very hard for artists to make a living today

premises.text: Space Bar streams live audio performances to mobile devices worldwide at high bitrate for a low price
premises.evidence_span: Space Bar streams live audio performances to mobile devices

premises.text: Fans can preview local shows free and then enter the venue or pay to join the same show remotely
premises.evidence_span: check out a couple of five-minute free previews, and if I like what I hear, I can just step into the club

premises.text: Live-stream listener data gives bands tour-planning intelligence and helps venues book acts
premises.evidence_span: It will help them plan their tours. It's business intelligence that will help venues book the hottest new acts

premises.text: Launch distribution runs through influential New York clubs and a Backplane partnership for large-artist fan communities
premises.evidence_span: launch Space Bar from some of the most influential clubs in New York City

premises.text: Simple push-button architecture scales so superstars can reach fans worldwide from an iPhone
premises.evidence_span: beautifully simple architecture that just works so that when superstars take the stage, they can reach out to all of their fans all over the world

value.text: Fans support artists by listening to live shows anywhere while artists better connect with and monetize fans
value.evidence_span: help musicians to better connect with their fans and to build a mobile platform to help those fans that wish to support artists to directly do so

secondary_value.text: Business intelligence for bands and venues from live-listenership data
secondary_value.evidence_span: business intelligence that will help venues book the hottest new acts

causal_links.evidence_span: For 99 cents, it's as though I'm there
With a push of a button, the artist is live, on the air

notes: 99-cent price and 256kbps bitrate folded into P2/P3 as quantitative detail of the live-stream offer. Artist/venue/festival market-size enumeration treated as framing, not separate premises. Stream-count poverty stats motivate P1 rather than adding a separate premise. Singletons D2–D4 retained as independently revisable BI, distribution, and scale modules.
